doc: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-lobby-shop-design.md 16.14. GUI-only keys of the egg-hatch cutscene (shown in a ViewportFrame, never placed in the world, so mesh_budget's world scenes leave them out): egg_<rarity>_top / egg_<rarity>_bot = the painted egg_<rarity> (kit/props/lobby_shop.py lobby_egg) split along one jagged crack into a hollow cap and cup, pivot = the whole egg's bottom centre (the halves line up with egg_<rarity> exactly), attachments Center (the half's middle) and Seam (the crack's mean height).
